verdict.rationale: Retention policies and on-demand erasure are a fair axis for a meeting recorder like Fathom, but the evidence pack never documents scheduled auto-deletion of transcripts or recordings, or any permanent data-erasure capability. The only delete operation shown removes a webhook, which is unrelated to erasing meeting data, and admin view permissions and download endpoints are adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set retention policies — auto-delete transcripts and recordings on a schedule — and permanently erase data on demand
